content.title: How to watch Diamondbacks vs. Phillies: TV channel and streaming options for April 12
content.text: The Philadelphia Phillies host the Arizona Diamondbacks at 1:35 p.m. ET on Sunday, with both teams hoping to win the series. Andrew Painter (1-0, 4.82 ERA) gets the start for the Phillies, who are 7-7 this season and third in the NL East. Zac Gallen (1-1, 3.00 ERA) is expected to start for the Diamondbacks, who are 8-7 and third in the NL West.How to watch Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Philadelphia Phillies Venue: Citizens Bank Park Time: 1:35 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: NBCS-PH and Dbacks.TV Watching in person?
